purpose: MC-114: MC-112's dsh arms (DSH, DSHF) and MC-113's omp arm (OMPF) on new items over corpus_v2, to settle forcing (DSHF vs DSH) and the harness (OMPF vs DSHF) with enough items. Part M: the 112 VMLU law items, pooled in the tests with MC-112/113's 134 Legal MC items. Part S: 400 closed-book ViBidLQA items (Luật Đấu thầu 2023).

direct.request: the campaign request of MC-90 to MC-111 (run_diagnostic_prospective.make_request with data/diagnostic_prospective_v1/protocol.json)

scoring.multiple_choice: the frozen MC extractor and scorer (score_vi_multimodel) on the agent's final text or B's response
scoring.reading: vi-reading-v3 (vi_reading_v3.rescore_row): token-F1 primary, EM and gold-token recall descriptive; vi-reading-v2 values kept beside

reports.note: run 1: 5 of 6 attempts complete; smoke-s1 with dsh ended technical (the proxy's first upstream connection timed out after 132 s, right after a VPN connect that took 19 minutes)
run 2, the whole smoke again with the owner's go: 6 of 6 complete

smoke.budget_basis: As MC-113: the earlier cards' real cost on Legal MC, scaled by what the smoke shows. Over both smoke runs a span attempt cost 2.12 times an MC attempt in dsh (mean 26,078 against 12,330 tokens) and 2.25 times in omp (94,642 against 42,057). Part M at MC-112/113's per-attempt cost on the 134 Legal MC items (DSH 5,337; DSHF 95,908; OMPF 81,637) and MC-111's B (235): 41.0 million over 224 attempts per arm. Part S at those costs times the ratio of its harness (DSH and DSHF 2.12, OMPF 2.25) over 800 attempts per arm, with C and O at MC-96's cost (163 and 840): 319.1 million. Projection 360.1 million; x 1.5 = 540.1 million; rounded up: 550,000,000.

part_M.items: pooled 246: MC-112/113's 134 Legal MC items (DSH and DSHF from MC-112, OMPF from MC-113) and this card's 112 VMLU items

stale_gold_items.rule: descriptive only: VMLU items whose audit note says the current law in corpus_v2 gives another answer, no listed answer, or repeals the provision the gold follows (fixed from the audit notes before any request)
